title: Pleased traveler
review_text: I have suitcases, but I had nothing to transport my suit and sport coat in without wrinkling them. I needed both for a trip. The bag was large enough I placed a full suit, a sport coat, slacks, and a couple dress shirts in it. The suit and sport coat were on wooden hangers, which take up more room, but I still had enough room for the rest. I was traveling by car, so I laid the garment bag on top of what else we had in the back of the car. When I carried the bag in and out of the house and where we stayed, I folded the bag in half, without wrinkling anything inside the bag. It was easy to handle, just extending my hangers through the opening at the top of the bag. I left the clothes in the bag, in the closet, until I needled them.

title: Got to measure
review_text: All carry ons are not equal and many airlines have a contraption passengers slide their bag into to make sure it fits...if not, must pay to check. title: Space saving hamper - stores flat
review_text: This dark blue / navy blue laundry hamper holds a fair amount of clothing or other laundry - its about 21 inches tall and 16 to 17 inches measured across (diameter I think). Those are my measurements, not whats in the description or on the package. It has a spiral ring type device that encircles the basket that keeps it upright and gives it a tubular shape when opened, and actually has a fairly good amount of tension in it, meaning that the basket is going to stay upright and not collapse down accidentally. There is also an attached cover, or lid, that can be zipped closed. It doesn't remove completely, thus no worries about it being lost. A strap is attached on each side of the top to make for easy carrying if its full. And when its empty, it collapses almost completely flat so it takes very little storage space. Great idea this was! So far I've used it twice, meaning I've filled it up and emptied into the washer twice. It seems like it will hold up well although I haven't had it long enough to know its long term durability. For now giving it 5 stars because I have no issues with it and its very functional in its design and usefulness. Russell in Scottsdale
